status: Articulated 2D vector rig, deterministic motion recipes, pose assets, and actual encoded MP4 samples. No audio or automatic lip sync.

source_api.rig: source/character_rig.cjs: rigSvg(character, state, options), rigGeometry(character, state, options)
source_api.motions: source/motion_library.cjs: MOTIONS, sampleMotion(motionId, seconds, character, options), durationForCharacter(motionId, character)

clip.production_export: Use source/render_character.cjs to render from the vector rig at the master resolution or export transparent PNG frames.
